outcome: Scores on the Child Behaviour Checklist/1½-5
cohort: 225 children born late preterm (34-36(+6) weeks gestation) in 2006 in Northern Ireland
finding: Late preterm infants admitted to NIC had significantly higher scores on the Aggressive Behaviour Subscale and the Externalising Problems Scale of the Child Behaviour Checklist/1½-5 at age 3 years compared to LPIs not admitted to NIC.
birth_weight: Not specified, but LPIs admitted to NIC had lower birth weight than those not admitted.
